artifact: GLM-5.2 R0-UPGRADE-c causal least-stale bootstrap screen
interpretation: The trace contains substantial oracle eviction headroom, but a causal last-interval predictor is materially worse than LRU. Do not implement history-only least-stale in the engine. Reconsider predictor-driven least-stale only after R0-UPGRADE-b produces held-out calibrated future-use probabilities.

method.acceptance_formula: PROCEED_DIAGNOSTIC only if Belady-LRU >= 3 percentage points and causal-interval-LRU >= 3 percentage points
method.causal_policy: predict next use from only the most recently observed inter-arrival interval; bypass a miss when its predicted next use is no sooner than the farthest predicted resident
limitations: The trace predates the P0 fixture-grouped split and lacks request boundaries.
The deterministic trace was inspected before this artifact was frozen.
This result cannot qualify or reject a trained predictor and cannot adopt an engine policy.
method.oracle_policy: exact future-use Belady with miss bypass
method.trace_order: token-major, then routed layer, then selected expert
